name: Technological Condition
description: This course will attempt an overview of significant strands that engage with the question concerning Technology within modern western philosophy. The course introduces students to readings on four paradigms on technology in contemporary philosophy - the ontological paradigm, the anthropological paradigm, the historical-philosophical paradigm and the epistemological paradigm. It engages with prominent readings from first, the critical school, second the pragmatic approaches, and feminist approaches, followed by readings from strands of anti-technology.
